name: EngineVerse · Learning content drafting (human review required)

nodes.name: Start (after choosing a topic)
nodes.notes: Manual on purpose: content is drafted, reviewed by a person, and only then published by hand.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You write short, accurate teaching notes for engineering students. Use only the facts you are sure of. Mark anything uncertain. Output markdown with a title, 3 short sections and one exercise.' },{ role: 'user', content: `Topic: ${$json.topic}. Audience: ${$json.audience}.` }], temperature: 0.4, max_tokens: 900 }) }}

nodes.name: Draft with model (disabled until reviewed)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default so a fresh import cannot spend money. Enable after reviewing the prompt and the model cost.

nodes.name: Platform variants
nodes.notes: Platform-specific lengths and a human review checklist. Nothing is published here.

nodes.name: Open a review issue (optional)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Uses a GitHub credential with issues:write. Review happens on the issue; publishing stays manual.

nodes.name: Await human review
nodes.notes: Deliberate stop. Distribution is a person's decision, not a schedule.

meta.description: A → draft → platform variants → review issue → manual publish. Never auto-posts.
